issue.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/encode/starlette/discussions/1673
Originally posted by **dwinston** June 3, 2022 I find that I can't GET or POST to a path containing a colon (":"). An example in FastAPI (which uses Starlette): ```python from fastapi import FastAPI app = FastAPI() @app.get("/items:queue") def queue_new_item(): return "An item has been queued for later inclusion." ``` On `uvicorn main:app --reload` (FYI Python 3.9.12 and FastAPI 0.78.0 on MacOS), I get a 404 response from `GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/items:queue`. I also filed this issue in the fastapi repo (https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/issues/4984), but I suspect that Starlette's use of colons for path parameter converters (https://www.starlette.io/routing/) may be playing a role here. Is this a bug? I am trying to follow the official google cloud APIs "custom methods" pattern : >For custom methods, they should use the following generic HTTP mapping: > https://service.name/v1/some/resource/name:customVerb
issue.title: URL path with colon (":") results in 404 not found
